## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

Product: Replicate model API (WaveSpeedAI accelerated serving). API model: wavespeedai/wan-2.1-t2v-720p. Settings: text-to-video, 720p. version                             needs  score

```sh
# bf16 · nvidia only
python generate.py --task t2v-14B --size 1280*720 --ckpt_dir ./Wan2.1-T2V-14B --offload_model True --prompt "Two anthropomorphic cats in comfy boxing gear and bright gloves fight intensely on a spotlighted stage."
# gguf-q8_0 + umt5 q8_0 (sd.cpp)
sd-cli -M vid_gen --diffusion-model models/wan2.1-t2v-14b-Q8_0.gguf --vae models/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors --t5xxl models/umt5-xxl-encoder-Q8_0.gguf -p "a lovely cat" --cfg-scale 6.0 --sampling-method euler -v -n "色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走" -W 832 -H 480 --diffusion-fa --offload-to-cpu --video-frames 33 --flow-shift 3.0
# gguf-q4_k_m + umt5 q8_0 (sd.cpp)
sd-cli -M vid_gen --diffusion-model models/wan2.1-t2v-14b-Q4_K_M.gguf --vae models/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors --t5xxl models/umt5-xxl-encoder-Q8_0.gguf -p "a lovely cat" --cfg-scale 6.0 --sampling-method euler -v -n "色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走" -W 832 -H 480 --diffusion-fa --offload-to-cpu --video-frames 33 --flow-shift 3.0
```
